questions.question: When Abraham's wife Sarah died in Hebron, what did Abraham do?

answers.text: He went out to mourn and weep for her
He left the land of Canaan for good
He sent word to his son Isaac

questions.question: After his wife Sarah died, Abraham told the Hittites he was a foreigner. What kind of site did he ask them to give him?
When Abraham asked to buy the cave of Machpelah, what did Ephron the Hittite first say about it?

answers.text: He would give it to Abraham as a gift
He would offer a different cave instead
He would ask Abraham to wait

questions.question: After Abraham bought the field and cave at Machpelah from Ephron, what did he do there?

answers.text: He buried his wife Sarah in the cave
He gave the field back to Ephron
He built a city on the field
